summary: Temporary debug access token not issued due to Okta SCIM race condition
description: Issue summary: A developer requested temporary debug/admin access via our internal console 'FeatureRollouts'. The usual flow issues a short-lived debug token after Okta group membership is confirmed via the SCIM provisioner. Impact: affected user did not receive any token; console showed 'pending' state and token issuance job logged an error. The incident is blocking one engineer from performing an urgent rollback for a customer-facing rollout. Recent changes: a bulk group rename migration (okta-group-migration job) ran within the same minute as the token-issue job for this user. Hypothesis: SCIM events out of order or a transient failure in our group lookup caused the token-issuer to skip creation without a retry.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Perform group rename in Okta for an admin group (simulate migration job)
2) Trigger temporary debug token issuance from console for a user who was member of the renamed group
3) Observe the token-issuer logs: if the SCIM lookup returns 404 or 409, the issuer currently exits without creating token
4) Repeat with delays and the token is created as expected (timing-sensitive).

investigation_notes: Initial triage by SRE (Diego): reproduced locally by running the migration tool concurrently with token-issue worker. Observed a race where SCIM returned a transient 404 for group lookup immediately after rename and before membership sync finished. Token-issuer codepath treats non-200 from SCIM as 'not a member' and returns without retry. Previously assumed SCIM is strongly consistent; bulk rename introduced window of inconsistency. Added hypothesis: missing idempotent semantics for group lookup and no retry/backoff. Correlated Slack thread #infra-auth (https://slack.redwood/team/infra-auth/p12345) and related runbook. Linked PR added to add retries and idempotent check: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-provisioner/pull/1142
workaround: Manual workaround: Support can manually create the short-lived token via admin console 'Create Debug Token' flow for affected user while SCIM sync completes. Steps: 1) Verify user identity via SSO audit. 2) Use internal admin tool (requires SSO admin role) to issue token and record in incident. Temporary measure until automatic fix is deployed.
resolution_notes: Planned fix: update token-issuer to tolerate transient SCIM 4xx/5xx by adding exponential retry (max 3 attempts) and an idempotent verification step that checks provisioning timestamp. Also add monitoring alert when token-issuer observes >1% transient SCIM failures. Patch PR created and under review (auth-provisioner#1142). Deployment plan: merge to canary, monitor token-issuance success rate in prod for 24h, then promote. Follow-up: add migration checklist to avoid bulk renames during high-priority rollouts.
notes_for_oncall: Oncall: if user reports 'pending' state for token issuance, check SCIM sync status and open this ticket. Manual token issuance permitted for urgent rollbacks. Do not run bulk Okta rename jobs during active rollouts; coordinate with Platform team.
